title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for management of chronic kidney disease and blood pressure.

HPI
The patient is a 68-year-old male presenting for a scheduled follow-up regarding his end stage renal disease. He currently undergoes maintenance hemodialysis three times per week. He reports feeling generally well today, noting no significant fatigue or new symptoms since his last visit. He continues to monitor his blood pressure at home, which he reports is generally stable. He denies any shortness of breath or significant edema.

Medication List
1. Lisinopril
2. Sevelamer
3. Furosemide
4. Erythropoietin alfa

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented. Vital signs show a blood pressure of 138/82 mmHg. Heart rate is 72 bpm. Lungs are clear to auscultation. No peripheral edema noted. Skin is intact and warm.

Assessment
1. End stage renal disease on maintenance hemodialysis.
2. Hypertension.

Plan
1. Continue current hemodialysis schedule.
2. Continue medications for hypertension and renal management.
3. Patient will follow up in four weeks for continued monitoring of renal function and blood pressure.
explanations: Hypertension with CKD stage 5 or ESRD: I12.0, plus N18.5/N18.6.
ESRD: N18.6. If a stage and ESRD are both documented, assign N18.6 only.
Patient on dialysis: add Z99.2 dependence on renal dialysis.

distractors.why: I12.9 is for stage 1-4 or unspecified CKD.
The classification presumes a link between hypertension and CKD.
Assign N18.6 only when ESRD is documented.
Dialysis status is reported with Z99.2.
